vision.title: Vision & Mission of Musolla Al-Widad
vision.statusNote: The complete official vision & mission statement is currently in final refinement by the pro-tem Committee of Musolla Al-Widad Kita Sejati.
vision.visionText: To establish Musolla Al-Widad Kita Sejati as a thriving spiritual haven that fosters knowledgeable, devout, and closely united residents, serving as a role model of harmonious community living.
missionList: Provide a clean, secure, and serene worship environment for all congregants and visitors.
Organize high-quality Islamic lectures, Quran study circles, and youth classes to cultivate noble character.
Strengthen neighborliness, unity, and mutual cooperation among all residency residents.
Manage infaq and waqf funds transparently, responsibly, and with the utmost integrity.

khairat.title: Funeral Welfare Fund (Khairat)
khairat.subtitle: Officially Affiliated Under Masjid Al-Ilmi Dengkil
khairat.lead: To ensure that funeral management (fardhu kifayah) is carried out smoothly, respectfully, and without financial distress to grieving families, Musolla Al-Widad Kita Sejati has joined under the Khairat Kematian program of Masjid Al-Ilmi Dengkil.
khairat.highlight: All Muslim residents of Kita Sejati Cybersouth are strongly encouraged to register as khairat members to secure peace of mind and protection for their beloved families.

benefits.title: Complete Funeral Management
benefits.desc: Covers ritual washing, shrouding (kafan), funeral prayers, and burial preparations at designated Islamic cemeteries.

benefits.title: Hearse Van Transportation
benefits.desc: Dedicated hearse logistics arranged from hospital/residence to the musolla and cemetery grounds.

benefits.title: Bereavement Compassionate Grant
benefits.desc: Immediate bereavement financial aid provided to the primary next of kin to alleviate urgent expenses.

benefits.title: Whole Household Coverage
benefits.desc: One registration covers the principal member, spouse, and eligible dependent children under constitutional age limits.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
faq.subtitle: Helpful answers to common questions asked by Kita Sejati residents.

items.q: Is Friday congregational prayer (Solat Jumaat) held at Musolla Al-Widad?
items.a: Currently, Musolla Al-Widad hosts the daily five prayers, Tarawih prayers in Ramadan, and special qiyamullail. Friday prayers are performed at Masjid Al-Ilmi Dengkil and neighboring kariah mosques until official approval is granted.

items.q: How can residents enroll in the Khairat Kematian program?
items.a: Musolla Al-Widad participates under the official Khairat Kematian program of Masjid Al-Ilmi Dengkil. Simply click the 'Register Khairat' button on this portal to access the Masjid Al-Ilmi e-Khairat system.

items.q: Can residents reserve the musolla space for family tahlil or doa selamat?
items.a: Yes. Residents are warmly welcomed to utilize the musolla for religious gatherings and tahlil. Please reach out to the Secretary at least one week in advance to schedule the session.

items.q: How can I volunteer to support musolla initiatives?
items.a: We welcome enthusiastic residents, particularly youth and working professionals, to contribute skills in our dakwah, media, welfare, or technical maintenance teams. Contact any committee member to get involved.

items.q: Where can I review the musolla's financial statements?
items.a: All audited monthly and annual financial statements are regularly published in PDF format under the 'Finance' section of this portal for public congregational transparency.
